text: Refactoring is the process of improving the internal structure of code without changing its external behavior. In other words, the program still works exactly the same way for the user, but the code behind it becomes cleaner and easier to manage. This practice focuses on readability, making the code simpler to understand for any developer who reads it. By regularly refactoring, teams can reduce technical debt, which is the extra work created by quick or messy coding. Instead of just adding new features, developers take time to tidy up, which saves time and effort in the long run.
